comparison.objective: Recover a sample carrier from beneath a retaining lip while keeping four samples upright; the candidate adjusts a gripper stop.
comparison.physical_skill: Coordinated two-arm translation and level load support, avoiding a lip and tilt, not threaded tool seating.
comparison.success_condition: Carrier reaches its stand released while samples stay upright; unsafe single-sided tilt latches zero.
comparison.reason: Bimanual coordination is generic; load leveling differs from countertorque on concentric fasteners.
